description: This Java class models the <tyrex-dataSource> element in an entity configuration XML file for the Apache OFBiz framework. It extends JdbcElement and encapsulates the data source name attribute, providing access to it. The class is designed to be thread-safe and performs validation during object construction.

classes.name: TyrexDataSource
classes.description: A thread-safe class that models the <tyrex-dataSource> element in an OFBiz entity configuration XML, encapsulating the dataSource-name attribute.
